messages.message: Hello, Akshay! How can I assist you today?
in your hotel have any AC room i want book for 2 days
Yes, we have AC rooms available at Hotel Triton. Could you please provide me with your arrival date and the number of adults and children for your booking?
we have 5 family members and we arrive on 2nd August at 3 PM
Thank you for the details. To proceed with your booking, could you please confirm the number of children in your group?
Great! I have your booking details: 5 adults arriving on 2nd August at 3 PM for 2 days. To finalize your booking, please fill out the enquiry form, and our team will contact you shortly.
